questions.title: Hitting a Provisional Ball Closer to the Hole Than Your First Ball
questions.question: If you hit a provisional ball from a spot that is closer to the hole than where you think your first ball is, what should you do?

choices.text: You can keep playing your provisional ball and it’s okay.
You are not allowed to hit a provisional ball from a spot closer to the hole than your first ball.
You get two extra shots but can keep playing.
You can play the provisional ball once, but then must stop if you don't find your first ball.

questions.explanation: You cannot play a provisional ball from a spot nearer to the hole than where your first ball might be. If you do, your provisional ball must be used instead, with a penalty.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: A second ball you play if you think your first ball might be lost or out of bounds.
A spot that is nearer to the flag or the hole you are trying to get the ball into.

questions.teachingTip: Walk and look for your first ball. Only play a provisional ball from the same place or further away from the hole—not closer.
likelyMisconceptions: Children might think it is fine to play a provisional ball from any spot.
Children may think you can play provisional balls from wherever you want if you haven't found the first ball yet.

questions.title: Provisional ball played past where the original ball is believed to be
questions.question: If you hit your provisional ball from a spot closer to the hole than where you think your original ball is, what is the result?

choices.text: You can keep playing your provisional ball with no penalty.
You must not play a provisional ball from closer to the hole than where your original ball is thought to be.
You get a two-stroke penalty but can keep playing.
You can play it once but need to switch if your original isn't found.

questions.explanation: You are not allowed to play a provisional ball from a spot nearer the hole than where you think your original ball lies. If you do, the provisional becomes your ball in play under penalty.
